item.tib: phywa tshe g.yang gi sgrub pa las bskang ba rad na'i phreng ba
item.coloph: ces pa'i dngos grub g.yang gi sgrub pa las/ skong ba rad na'i phreng ba 'di yang / 'chi med gtsug phud kyis gnod sbyin sde tshogs las la bsdus nas ma 'ongs pa'i don du gshen gsang ba 'dus pa la bstan/ des stag la me 'bar la bstan/ des lha klu mi yi gshen gsum la bstan/ des snang ba mdog can la brgyud/ des dran pa nam mkha' la brgyud/ dran pas rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum phyes nas/ grol thob rig 'dzin brgyad la gdams/ dus der ban btsun phrag dogs dbang gis bon rnams snub pas/ g.yung drung gi bon rnams gter du gshegs nas/ stang chen dmu tsa gyer med kyis bon rnams zab par gzigs nas/ tshe g.yang kha sprod 'di yang bon sde cha gnyis phyes nas cha gcig rgyung srub shel brag la sbas/ cha gcig tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi phyag tu phul nas/ tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyis ma gros g.yu'i mtsho mo'i dbus su sbas/ gter srung rdo rje 'bar ba la gtad do/ phyis su rten 'brel dus la bab tshe/ 'gro ba'i mgon po tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi snying bu/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i rjes 'breng*/ tshe dbang bde chen snying po 'am/ gsang mtshan g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag/ bka' gter chig dril du dngos grub du bab pa'o/ de'i skabs bstan 'gro'i grogs por gyur pa shes rab phun tshogs kyis rin chen dang po rten 'brel brda' mtshon te/ nan cher bskul ba la brten nas yod mtshams rigs ldan bu slob 'ga' yis bskul ba la brten nas shar grol smin gling du dkar chag yig ger btab pa'o/ dge des bon bstan yun du gnas shing 'gro kun longs spyod phun sum 'tshogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
